block.prompt:
Choose the best answer for each question according to Text A.

What is the main paradox that the writer describes?  (A) Cities have too many parks and not enough housing. / B) Young people are highly connected online but feel lonely in real life. / C) London is more expensive than Amsterdam or Vienna. / D) Retired people are the loneliest group in cities.)
Why does the writer say people avoid eye contact on public transport?  (A) They are all looking at their phones for entertainment. / B) They dislike the other passengers. / C) Their brains cannot process so many social signals at once. / D) It is considered impolite in British culture.)
What do the urban planning experiments in Amsterdam and Vienna have in common?  (A) They focus on building more underground car parks. / B) They aim to increase the number of shopping centres. / C) They create spaces that encourage people to spend time together. / D) They replace public transport with cycling lanes.)
block.answer_key: Q1: B. Q2: C — "It is a coping mechanism for a world that sends us more human signals every day than our Stone Age brains were ever designed to process." Q3: C — The shared aim is creating 'social infrastructure' to encourage conversation and togetherness.
watch_outs: Bei Q1 wählen Schüler:innen oft D, weil der Anfang des Textes die Nachbarin Margaret erwähnt. Sie lesen nicht über den ersten Absatz hinaus, bevor sie antworten.
Bei Q2 ist A ein attraktiver Distraktor; das Handy wird jedoch nie erwähnt — sorgfältige Lektüre ist entscheidend.
